map.输入眼轴长度、角膜曲率、前房深度与晶状体厚度，选择人工晶状体计算公式，估算正视化: Enter axial length, corneal curvature, anterior-chamber depth and lens thickness, choose an IOL formula, estimate emmetropic target IOL power.
map.📖 查看「眼部A超 / IOL 度数计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Ocular A-Scan / IOL Power Calculation User Guide"
map.K̄ = (K1 + K2)/2；SRK II：P = A′ − 2.5·AL: K̄ = (K1 + K2)/2; SRK II: P = A' − 2.5·AL − 0.9·K̄; SRK/T: P = A − 2.5·AL − 0.9·K̄ (segment-corrected by axial length); Hoffer Q approx: P = 5.45 − 0.87·AL − 0.22·K̄ + 0.5·ACD
map.三种公式均以眼轴 AL(mm) 与平均角膜曲率 K̄(D) 为核心，A 常数随眼: All three formulas center on axial length AL (mm) and mean corneal curvature K̄ (D); the A constant is segment-corrected by axial length; the result is an emmetropic (target refraction 0 D) IOL-power estimate.
map.💡 IOL 度数估算公式：SRK II P=A−2.5AL−0.9K；SRK-T: 💡 IOL power formula: SRK II P=A−2.5AL−0.9K; SRK-T and Hoffer Q are more complex geometric-optics formulas; this tool uses a simplified version for reference.
map.本工具为教育/估算用途，实际手术请选择经校准的生物测量仪与专业 IOL 计算公式: This tool is for education/estimation; for actual surgery use a calibrated biometer and a professional IOL formula.
map.特殊眼轴（过短或过长）、角膜屈光手术后等需要使用特殊公式。: Special axial lengths (too short or too long), post-corneal-refractive surgery, etc. need special formulas.
map.对比不同 A 常数的结果。: Compare results across different A constants.
map.若 AL=24.5，则 Power ≈ 118.4 − 61.25 − 39.3: If AL=24.5, then Power ~ 118.4 − 61.25 − 39.375 ~ 17.78 D; each 1 mm AL gain lowers power ~2.5 D.
map.SRK-II 用轴长经验修正 A 常数；SRK/T 引入有效晶体位置 ELP 更: SRK-II empirically corrects A by axial length; SRK/T introduces effective lens position ELP for more accuracy, see iol-power.
map.是，用两条主经线平均 K 值近似球面等效角膜屈光力。: Yes, the mean of the two principal meridians' K approximates spherical-equivalent corneal power.
map.根据眼部 A 超或光学生物测量获得的眼轴长度、角膜曲率、前房深度与晶状体厚度，估: From ocular A-scan or optical biometry axial length, corneal curvature, anterior-chamber depth and lens thickness, estimate the intraocular lens (IOL) power.
map.支持 SRK II、SRK-T、Hoffer Q 三种常用公式: Supports SRK II, SRK/T and Hoffer Q, three common formulas
